name: Biotechnology Young Entrepreneur Award
benefit:
1. The winning teams will be given cash awards by the Kerala Biotechnology Commission.
   1. Cash award for winners - first prize ₹1,00,000/-, second prize ₹50,000/- and third prize ₹25,000/-.
   1. The awardees will be encouraged to establish start-ups through facilitation and support after evaluation and recommendation by an Expert Committee.
_eligibility_text: 1. Students who are pursuing post-graduate programmes (including integrated PG degree programmes), doctoral degrees, B.E. or B.Tech. in Biotechnology or in the area of life sciences related to biotechnology (bioinformatics/Molecular biology/microbiology/biochemistry/Genetics and/or related subjects) from universities/Institutes in the State of Kerala are eligible to apply.
